001package pkg_engine;
002
003import javazoom.jl.player.Player;
004
005import java.io.FileInputStream;
006
007/** Plays an MP3 file in a loop on a background thread. */
008public class MusicPlayer {
009    /** MP3 file path to play on loop. */
010    private String aFilePath;
011
012    /** Active JLayer player instance for the current playback cycle. */
013    private Player aPlayer;
014
015    /** Background thread responsible for continuous playback. */
016    private Thread aThread;
017
018    /** Indicates whether playback loop should keep running. */
019    private boolean aIsPlaying;
020
021    /**
022     * Creates a music player for the given MP3 path.
023     *
024     * @param pFilePath the local MP3 file path
025     */
026    public MusicPlayer(final String pFilePath) {
027        this.aFilePath = pFilePath;
028        this.aIsPlaying = false;
029    } // MusicPlayer()
030
031    /** Starts playing the MP3 in a loop on a background thread. */
032    public void playLoop() {
033        this.aIsPlaying = true;
034        this.aThread =
035                new Thread(
036                        () -> {
037                            while (this.aIsPlaying) {
038                                try {
039                                    FileInputStream vFIS = new FileInputStream(this.aFilePath);
040                                    this.aPlayer = new Player(vFIS);
041                                    this.aPlayer.play();
042                                    this.aPlayer.close();
043                                } catch (Exception e) { // playLoop()
044                                    System.out.println("Error playing music: " + e.getMessage());
045                                    this.aIsPlaying = false;
046                                }
047                            }
048                        });
049        this.aThread.setDaemon(true);
050        this.aThread.start();
051    } // playLoop()
052
053    /** Stops the music. */
054    public void stop() {
055        this.aIsPlaying = false;
056        if (this.aPlayer != null) {
057            this.aPlayer.close();
058    }
059    } // stop()
060}
